summary: Designed and upgraded a MAF-compatible plugin marketplace with dotagent rules, a PMCRO control plane, phase skills, agent projections, strategy families, and a Trail record.
decisions: Use create-skill as the canonical skill name inside the skill-creator plugin.
Keep skill-creator and pmcro as separate plugins.
Use SKILL.md packages for MAF discovery and agents/ as host-specific projections.
Use typed envelopes and forward-only Planner-Maker-Checker-Reflector-Orchestrator routing.
Use bounded reasoning strategy families without storing private chain-of-thought.
Rename the umbrella repository to pmcro-skill-creator.
earned_constraints: MAF skills, dotagent rules, and PMCRO runtime state remain separate layers.
Phase transitions use typed structured messages, not slash-command text.
Webhook ingress and message queues belong to the PMCRO runtime, not individual phase skills.
The Checker must use independent ground-truth evidence before ACCEPT.
next_seed: Add durable queue and webhook adapters, then connect the phase skills to a .NET MAF host with explicit script approval and Trail persistence.
